title: Truly Vanilla
description: A pack that aims to fix and bring back the feeling of Minecraft
body:
# **PLEASE READ BEFORE PLAYING**

this modpack has mods that have to be enabled when making a world, the villager rebalance,
death changes and world generation have to be configured before starting a world, enable "allow cheats" and the game rules: "daily re-rolls" and "allow map rerolls". I'm currently trying to fix these issues

## **description**
Over the years, Minecraft has been slowly losing it's identity, focusing more on RPG elements and eliminating the core of the game! Truly Vanilla aims to remedy these problems and make the whole game more coheasive and put together without adding features that stray too far from Minecraft. This pack caters to both the intrinsically, and extrinsically motivated with creative freedom, and engauging gameplay.

features include:
- "Vibrant Visuals"
- reworked movement
- rewoked transportation
- reworked progression
- more decorations
- various QOL changes
- easy multiplayer
- immersive vanilla feel
- reworked enchanting
- reworked combat
- reworked maps
- and much, MUCH more!
